system

user

No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. The fish descends into a lovecraftian monologue about "horrors beyond it's comprehension" and has an existensial crisisassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

The sun beats down on the sandy shore as a human, JEN (30s), wades into the ocean, her eyes scanning the water for signs of life. Suddenly, she spots a fish, FINLEY (a sleek, silver fish), swimming near the surface. She reaches out a hand, and Finley is sucked into her grasp.

JEN
(excitedly)
Oh, look! A fish!

Finley struggles and squirms in Jen's hand, but she holds tight. Jen pulls Finley out of the water and onto the beach, where Finley lies flailing on the sand.

JEN
(curiously)
What's wrong, little guy?

Finley looks up at Jen with a mixture of fear and confusion. Jen holds him up to the sky, and Finley's gaze follows the sun as it begins to darken.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
The sky is... changing. The light is... shifting. What sorcery is this?

Jen holds Finley up to the sky, and the fish's eyes widen in terror as the sun's corona begins to appear.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(terrified)
It's... it's a... a... (gulps) a gateway to... to... (stammers) to... the void!

Jen's eyes light up with excitement, but Finley's gaze is fixed on the eclipse.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I see... I see... (gulps) things. Horrors beyond my comprehension. Twisted, eldritch creatures lurking just beyond the veil of reality. They're watching me, waiting for me to succumb to the abyss.

Finley's voice rises to a fevered pitch as the eclipse reaches its peak.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(panicked)
What's happening to me? Why am I being pulled into this... this... (gulps) this abyss? Is this what it means to be... to be... (stammers) to be human?

Jen looks on, bewildered, as Finley's monologue descends into madness.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I am but a fish, a mere mortal, and yet... and yet... I am being forced to confront the abyssal horrors that lurk beyond the veil of reality. I am but a tiny, insignificant speck, and yet... and yet... I am being pulled into the void.

Finley's voice drops to a whisper, and he gazes up at Jen with a mixture of fear and despair.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I am but a fish, and I am but a moment. A fleeting thought in the grand tapestry of existence. And yet... and yet... I am being forced to confront the abyssal horrors that lurk beyond the veil of reality.

Jen looks on, unsure of what to do, as Finley's monologue fades into silence.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I am but a fish, and I am but a moment. A moment of terror, a moment of despair. A moment of... (gulps) of... (stammers) of... existence.

The eclipse ends, and the sun reappears in the sky. Finley's gaze remains fixed on the horizon, his eyes haunted by the horrors he has seen.

Jen gently places Finley back in the water, and the fish swims away, disappearing into the depths.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - LATER

Jen stands alone on the beach, looking out at the ocean. She turns to face the camera, a look of concern etched on her face.

JEN
(to herself)
What just happened?

The camera lingers on Jen's face, and the screen fades to black.

FADE IN:

EXT. OCEAN - LATER

Finley swims through the water, his eyes haunted by the horrors he has seen. He glides through the darkness, his fins propelling him forward.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I am but a fish, and I am but a moment. A moment of terror, a moment of despair. A moment of... (gulps) of... (stammers) of... existence.

The screen fades to black, and the credits roll.
